clauses.clause_label: License: personal, educational, or experimental use
clauses.scope_note: Permission concerns this project. The listed purposes are alternatives; the text does not specify notice, source, or other distribution conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: At least one of personal_purpose, educational_purpose, or experimental_purpose must apply.

clauses.scope_note: Commercial use of this project is expressly allowed. The adjacent warranty and support disclaimer does not qualify that permission.
clauses.condition_explanation: No condition on commercial use is stated in this sentence.

coverage_notes: The text describes the project as educational and experimental, but does not specify whether it is software, a model, or another artifact; OriginalArtifact refers to the project itself.

The security notice instructs users not to upload credentials or other sensitive information publicly and to revoke or regenerate exposed credentials. Those instructions concern credentials, not the licensed artifact, so they are not represented as artifact-use clauses.

The text assigns users responsibility for configuration, API usage, costs, privacy, security, and compliance with third-party service terms, but does not specify payment terms or those services' conditions.
